title: Cloudflare One Gateway traffic unable to connect to Cloudflare domains that are regionalized

timeline.body: We are investigating reports of connection drops and TCP resets affecting requests routed through Cloudflare WARP and Gateway that aims for Cloudflare Regional Services hostnames and domains. Engineering has identified the root cause and is preparing a fix for release
timeline.label: identified

timeline.body: A fix has been implemented and we are monitoring the results.
timeline.label: monitoring
